name: Only One ~Sayaka Futari Dake no Kyuudoujou~
original_name: オンリーワン～さやか二人だけの弓道場～
source:
Main character is a manager of an archery club. There is a genius archer Sayaka in the club, but she's unable to show her talents in full because of emptiness in the heart. Even physical intimacy can not unseal it. But gradually things start to change...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是弓道部经理。部里有一名天才弓箭手沙耶香，却因内心空虚无法充分发挥才能。即使身体亲密接触也无法解开这份空虚。但事情逐渐开始改变……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
